title: Holt health
description: Is Holt working right now: errors, speed, the queue, the database pool, GitHub points.

panels.title: Site
panels.description: githolt.com from outside: Cloudflare, the tunnel, the edge, the web app.

panels.title: API servers
panels.description: Server containers answering /metrics. 2 for a moment during a deploy.

panels.title: Requests failing
panels.description: Share of API requests ending in a 5xx, last 5 minutes. Alert: over 5%.

panels.title: p95 response
panels.description: 19 in 20 API requests start answering within this (0 with no traffic). Alert: over 2 s.

panels.title: Longest wait in queue
panels.description: How long the longest-waiting person's check has been queued. Alert: over 60 s.

panels.title: Waiting for a DB connection
panels.description: Requests and jobs waiting for a pool connection now. Alert: above 0 for 5 minutes.

panels.title: GitHub points left
panels.description: GraphQL points until the hourly reset. Warm passes stop under 1500; alert under 500. Blank until the server has made a GitHub call since the last reset.

panels.title: Last deploy
panels.description: From /__build: whether the last production deploy failed or is held back.

panels.title: Alerts firing now
panels.description: Empty is good. What to do about each: deploy/monitoring/README.md.

panels.title: Response time
panels.description: Time to the first byte of the answer. The line is the alert: p95 over 2 s.

panels.title: Page load, probed
panels.description: Seconds to fetch the home page every 30 s: from outside (public) and straight at the edge (internal). The gap is Cloudflare and the tunnel.

panels.title: Jobs queued and running
panels.description: From the jobs table, so every process's jobs are counted.

panels.title: Workers busy
panels.description: Busy user workers at the dashed line means people's checks are queueing.

panels.title: Wait in the queue
panels.description: The line is the alert for the user lane: over 60 s. Background work is meant to wait.

panels.title: Connection pool
panels.description: In use at the dashed line with anything waiting is a full pool.

panels.title: Postgres connections
panels.description: Open connections per database against Postgres's limit (the budget is in deploy/prod/compose.yml).

panels.title: GitHub points left
panels.description: Refills every hour. Under 1500 warm passes stop; under 500 is the alert.

panels.title: AI spend against the budget
panels.description: The budget is HOLT_AI_BUDGET_USD: 0 means AI is off. merge_plan is the merge plan.

panels.title: Warm pass
panels.description: After an engine change a warm pass redoes old reports: the first line falls to 0.

targets.legendFormat: repos still on an older engine
